captions: 9:40 a.m. Public library. Your coffee went cold an hour ago.
Cover letter. Send. Refresh. Another one.
“We regret to inform you…” Number thirty-eight.
Across the table, an old man closes his Mushaf. He looks so calm.
You trusted your CV, your contacts, your luck. Not Him.
You close the laptop. The mosque is two streets away.
Cold water from the fountain. Your hands stop shaking.
Two rak'ahs. Then, finally: “Ya Allah, choose for me.”
You still send number thirty-nine. But now it's in His hands.

post.caption:
38 applications sent. Not one du'a for the job. 🌙

9:40 a.m. in the library, cold coffee, rejection number thirty-eight. You trusted your CV, your contacts, your luck — everything except Him.

“And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.” (65:3)

Before your next application: two rak'ahs. This morning.
